# Nevatal Chat

> An open-source AI tools hub: seventeen focused AI tools for writing,
> translation, summarising, document Q&A, image generation and data analysis,
> running on the visitor's own OpenAI, Gemini or OpenRouter API key.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chat.nevatal.id/): product overview and tool launcher
- [About](https://chat.nevatal.id/about): what Nevatal is and how it works
- [Courses](https://chat.nevatal.id/courses): free practical AI courses
- [Sitemap](https://chat.nevatal.id/sitemap.xml): all public pages
